operations.name: Saw Cut Tubular Blanks
operations.setup_note: Clamp certified near-net seamless mechanical tubing in supported saw jaws and cut individual blanks against a length stop. Retain facing allowance at both ends.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the unmachined opposite-end tube in bored soft jaws, using the tube axis and first faced end as process references. Machine the exposed collar and central OD segment, size the accessible bore segment, and form the first-end face serrations with a turret-mounted face-knurl tool before unloading.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse into profiled soft jaws supporting the finished central OD and first collar, locating axially against a protected first-end reference without loading the serration crests. Face to final under-knurl length, finish the remaining OD and bore segments without a junction step, and form the second-end serrations in this clamping.

operations.name: Production Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the completed sleeve in a non-marring bench cradle and rapidly remove machining burrs from both ends and bore entries. Break unspecified sharp edges within the drawing limit, preserving the defined serration profile, then clean and blow out chips.

operations.name: Bulk Phosphate Coating
operations.setup_note: Load the 100-piece order into one suitable bulk barrel, with any same-lot test specimen included subject to barrel capacity. Alkaline clean, pickle or activate as required, rinse, and phosphate all specified surfaces per PS-119.0, including the prescribed final rinsing and drying.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Quality Gate
operations.setup_note: Present finished, coated samples to dedicated bore plug and OD snap gauges, a length/shoulder fixture, and a serration profile comparator under the approved control plan. Verify specified dimensions, tooth profile, edge condition and phosphate coverage, recording first-article and SPC results rather than performing a full CMM layout.

operations.name: Sample Crush Test
operations.setup_note: Fixture a same-lot finished sacrificial specimen in a calibrated compression tester according to PS-122.10 and retain the load-displacement report. Provisionally test one additional specimen for this 100-piece order so destructive sampling does not reduce the delivery quantity.

clarifications.question: Does the Ø20.25 ±0.50 callout define the bore-entry chamfer mouth rather than a second cylindrical bore diameter?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally treat Ø16.25 ±0.15 as the continuous through bore and Ø20.25 ±0.50 as the chamfer-mouth diameter; obtain confirmation before machining.

clarifications.question: Are the two 2.00 ±0.50 bore-entry chamfers specified at 45 degrees?
What numerical general-tolerance schedule governs the untoleranced dimensions on this drawing?
Does the title-block minimum yield strength of 435 MPa apply to this finished component?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat 435 MPa minimum yield as applicable and procure certified cold-drawn seamless mechanical tubing that satisfies it without an added heat-treatment operation.

clarifications.question: Can near-net seamless mechanical tubing at nominal Ø32.50 OD × Ø15.25 ID be supplied?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the nearest available certified seamless tube with OD clearing the maximum collar diameter and an undersize bore permitting cleanup; revise stock dimensions before release.

clarifications.question: Can you supply the applicable revision of phosphate specification PS-119.0?
clarifications.suggested_default: Quote in-house bulk phosphating provisionally, with coating build, pretreatment, post-treatment and acceptance details held for specification review.

clarifications.question: Can you supply the applicable revision of crush-test specification PS-122.10?
clarifications.suggested_default: Allow for subcontracted compression testing, but do not infer fixture orientation or acceptance criteria from the extracted 165 kN, 82.5 kN and 0.38 mm values.

clarifications.question: What crush-test sampling frequency is required for this order?
clarifications.suggested_default: One test per 100 delivered pieces using an additional same-lot sacrificial component.

clarifications.question: What inspection frequency is required for characteristics identified by the hexagon inspection symbol?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use first-article and SPC sampling unless the customer control plan requires a different frequency.

assumptions.text: World Z is the sleeve longitudinal axis; section A-A axis labels are view-local. No drawing datums are invented, and all workholding references are process references.

ALM-STOCK-002 overrides solid-bar selection: provisional precision seamless tube is Ø32.50 OD × Ø15.25 ID, cut to 83.88 mm. These are procurement targets, not a confirmed catalogue size; the tube must meet the drawing material and applicable strength requirements.
The route provisionally uses a Ø16.25 through bore with Ø20.25 chamfer mouths and 45-degree entry chamfers. Conflicting source bore interpretations remain a machining-release gate.
ASME Y14.5M-1994 does not supply numerical decimal-place tolerances. The extraction assumption assigning automatic ±0.13 mm or ±1-degree tolerances is not adopted.

The two lathe operations implement one consolidated G71/G70 OD profile cycle per end. Diameter-specific sub-operations are segments of those cycles, not repeated full-envelope roughing; collars receive cleanup cuts, while the central OD retains its actual tube-to-step reduction.

Each setup machines only its exposed OD and bore segments. Central OD segments are blended without duplicate full-length removal, and opposing bore segments receive a controlled junction overlap using suitably rigid boring tooling; the approximately 2.4 overall length-to-OD ratio does not require center support.

Each end receives lathe-produced annular face serrations using dedicated tooling, provisionally 30 teeth within the specified 28–32 range. The annular boundaries are taken as Ø20.25 to Ø26.90; no axial straight-knurl length or VMC/SPM serration operation is introduced.

Dedicated groove_od steps form the two R2 shoulder-transition fillets after finishing adjacent surfaces; they do not introduce uncalled-for grooves. Separate shoulder-facing steps establish collar widths, and general edge breaks remain within 0.5 mm maximum without altering the specified tooth profile.

Turning-template center drilling is omitted because the blank is hollow and needs no center support; rough boring is replaced by light finish sizing of the supplied tube bore. Threading is omitted because no threads exist, and part-off is omitted because blanks are saw-cut.

The preloaded milling sequence is omitted entirely because all defined geometry is lathe-accessible. Hole-making spotting, pilot/full/peck drilling are omitted because the tube supplies the hole; reaming and tapping are unnecessary, recess operations are absent, bore-entry countersinking is implemented by chamfer_turn, and hole deburring is included at the bench.

All machining precedes phosphating. Provisionally coat all surfaces in one bulk load without masking; no H7-or-tighter bore, threads or coating exclusion is specified, so masking and unmasking are omitted. Cure and embrittlement bake are omitted for this unhardened low-carbon-steel phosphate route unless PS-119.0 or certified material condition requires them; final coated dimensions must remain within drawing limits.

No hardening, grinding or honing is added. Material strength is addressed through certified stock procurement, not an invented heat-treatment cycle; hardness remains unknown and machinability is medium throughout.

Apply the organizational production-cycle guidance in Pass 2: two consolidated tubular turning setups, rapid deburr/clean, batch coating, short gauge-based inspection and amortized sample testing. No machining, bench, inspection or testing cycle-time formula inputs are populated in this pass.

A calibrated tester and fixtures suitable for the specified crush loads are not demonstrated by the listed in-house test-bench capabilities, so crush testing is subcontracted through special_testing. One additional same-lot component is provisionally processed for destructive testing; the required sampling plan remains subject to approval.
